function.name: prepare_confirmation
function.description: After booking, record the caller choice of SMS, email, or no confirmation. SMS uses only the booked confirmed callback. Email must be supplied by caller. Returns recipient and confirmation_token. Does NOT send. For email read back the returned address and wait for explicit confirmation.

email.description: Caller-supplied email, required only for channel=email. Omit for SMS or none. Read back and confirm before queuing.
